## {.toolbar }

```{python}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

import sys, os

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "..")))
from src.backend.backend_functions import *

initialize_data()

standings = get_vintage_standings().copy()
standings = add_season_draft_labels(standings)

# Newest draft first; Inputs.table preserves input order until a header is
# clicked, so this is the default view.
standings = standings.sort_values("draft_id", ascending=False)

COLUMNS = [
    "season_draft_label", "player", "match_points", "standing",
    "game_points", "games_played", "MWP", "OMP", "GWP", "OGP",
]

missing = [c for c in COLUMNS if c not in standings.columns]
if missing:
    raise KeyError(f"get_vintage_standings() is missing columns: {missing}")

standings = standings[COLUMNS]
standings["season_draft_label"] = standings["season_draft_label"].astype(str)
standings["player"] = standings["player"].astype(str)

draft_labels = ["All drafts"] + list(standings["season_draft_label"].unique())
players = ["All players"] + sorted(standings["player"].unique())

ojs_define(
    draft_labels=draft_labels,
    players=players,
    standings=standings,
)
```

```{ojs}
//| panel: input
viewof draftPick = Inputs.select(draft_labels, {
  label: "Draft",
  value: draft_labels[0]
})

viewof playerPick = Inputs.select(players, {
  label: "Player",
  value: players[0]
})

viewof search = Inputs.text({
  label: "Search",
  placeholder: "Player or draft...",
  submit: false
})
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
standingsData = transpose(standings)
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Replaces the Dash DataTable's per-column `filter_action`: two exact-match
// selects plus a case-insensitive substring search across both text columns.
standingsRows = {
  const query = (search ?? "").trim().toLowerCase();
  return standingsData.filter(d =>
    (draftPick === "All drafts" || d.season_draft_label === draftPick) &&
    (playerPick === "All players" || d.player === playerPick) &&
    (query === "" ||
      String(d.player).toLowerCase().includes(query) ||
      String(d.season_draft_label).toLowerCase().includes(query))
  );
}
```

```{ojs}
//| output: false
// Percentage columns can be null for players with no recorded opponents.
fmt2 = x => (x == null || Number.isNaN(x)) ? "" : d3.format(".2f")(x)

standingCell = x => htl.html`<span style="font-weight: ${x === 1 ? 700 : 400};
  color: ${x === 1 ? "var(--bs-success)" : "inherit"};
  font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums">${x}</span>`
```

# Main Content

## Row

```{ojs}
//| title: "Vintage Cube Standings"
standingsRows.length === 0
  ? html`<p class="text-muted">No standings match the current filters.</p>`
  : Inputs.table(standingsRows, {
      columns: [
        "season_draft_label", "player", "match_points", "standing",
        "game_points", "games_played", "MWP", "OMP", "GWP", "OGP"
      ],
      header: {
        season_draft_label: "Draft ID",
        player: "Player",
        match_points: "Match Points",
        standing: "Standing",
        game_points: "Game Points",
        games_played: "Games Played",
        MWP: "Match Win % (MWP)",
        OMP: "Opp Match Win % (OMP)",
        GWP: "Game Win % (GWP)",
        OGP: "Opp Game Win % (OGP)"
      },
      format: {
        standing: standingCell,
        MWP: fmt2,
        OMP: fmt2,
        GWP: fmt2,
        OGP: fmt2
      },
      align: {
        match_points: "right", standing: "right", game_points: "right",
        games_played: "right", MWP: "right", OMP: "right",
        GWP: "right", OGP: "right"
      },
      width: {
        season_draft_label: 130,
        player: 140
      },
      rows: 30,
      layout: "auto"
    })
```
